summary: Frontend mobile retest at 375x667. Auth screen loads and login with padre.test@timeguard.dev / Familia123 succeeds against Supabase. Dashboard load immediately fails with the 'Falta preparar Supabase' error panel because the Supabase schema is only partially applied. PostgREST returns 404 for public.family_members (and several other tables), which short-circuits load() before any tab, pairing, block, extra-time-request or sign-out flow can be exercised. Pairing modal, DeviceRow block switch, simulate-request/approve/deny and Ajustes sign-out could not be validated end-to-end because they all depend on the dashboard rendering.

critical.issue: PostgREST returns 404 PGRST205 'Could not find the table public.family_members in the schema cache'. This is the exact call load() makes first, so every authenticated user hits the error panel.
404 PGRST205 - table missing. Would break usage aggregation as soon as a device exists.

integration_issues.issue: supabase.from('family_members').select(...) returns memberError because the table does not exist in Supabase, triggering the 'Falta preparar Supabase' error panel and blocking every downstream flow (tabs, pairing, block, requests, sign-out).

action_items: Re-run the FULL /app/supabase/schema.sql against the Supabase project (slsuxbfpxitbhqdoymog). Currently only profiles, families, devices, extra_time_requests and notifications exist; family_members, device_sessions, app_usage, device_limits, managed_apps and schedules are missing, so RLS helpers (is_family_member, is_device_member) and load() cannot work.
After re-applying the schema, ensure the trigger on_auth_user_created ran for padre.test@timeguard.dev (so a profiles row exists). If not, insert one manually.
Consider reloading PostgREST schema cache (Supabase Dashboard > Database > API > 'Reload schema' or NOTIFY pgrst, 'reload schema') after DDL to avoid the PGRST205 caching gotcha.

In Index.tsx load(), when creating a family via `supabase.from('families').insert(...).select('id').single()`, check for created.error and surface it (currently a failure leaves member null and we fall through to setBusy(false) with an empty, non-error state).
Realtime handler on line 68 calls load() on any change and load() sets busy=true, so the whole dashboard flashes the spinner on every remote update. Consider a lighter refresh path.
Realtime subscription for extra_time_requests has no family/device filter and will fire for all rows the RLS lets through (fine functionally, but noisy).
critical_code_review_comments: Every dashboard render is gated by a single family_members query; schema drift instantly bricks the app. Add a guarded fallback UI that at minimum lets the user sign out (already present) and shows the raw Supabase error to speed debugging (currently only a generic Spanish message is shown).

Index.tsx is a single 91-line file with 6 components, ~30-column-wide lines. It works but violates the >700 line rule only trivially; readability is the real cost — recommend splitting AuthScreen, Dashboard, Summary, Activity, Controls, Settings, Pairing, DeviceRow into their own files.
supabase.ts throws at import time if EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL / ANON_KEY are missing; fine for prod but will crash the Metro web bundle rather than degrade gracefully.

success_rate.backend: Supabase reachable, auth OK. 6/11 required tables missing (~45% schema coverage).
success_rate.frontend: Auth screen 100%. Dashboard/pairing/requests/sign-out: 0% (blocked by backend schema).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Credentials padre.test@timeguard.dev / Familia123 work (Supabase auth OK, session persists). Reproduce the blocker with: curl -H 'apikey: <anon>' 'https://slsuxbfpxitbhqdoymog.supabase.co/rest/v1/family_members?select=family_id&limit=1' -> HTTP 404 PGRST205. Once schema is re-applied and cache reloaded, exercise: login -> auto-create family (families+family_members insert) -> tab-resumen loads -> '+ Vincular' -> pairing-code visible -> pairing-generate creates device (DeviceRow with block-<id>) -> block toggle flips devices.blocked -> tab-actividad -> simulate-request -> request-<id> pending with approve/deny -> approve/deny updates status -> tab-ajustes -> Cerrar sesión -> back to auth-email. All testIDs are already in place in /app/frontend/app/index.tsx.
rca_of_issue: Root cause: The Supabase schema is only partially applied to project slsuxbfpxitbhqdoymog. Executing /app/supabase/schema.sql in Supabase must have failed part-way (or an older subset was applied), leaving family_members, device_sessions, app_usage, device_limits, managed_apps and schedules missing. Dashboard.load() calls supabase.from('family_members')... first; PostgREST answers 404 PGRST205, memberError is truthy, and the app renders the 'Falta preparar Supabase' panel, hiding every other tested flow. Mitigation: paste the entire schema.sql into Supabase SQL editor and run it (idempotent thanks to create table if not exists / create policy is not idempotent — drop existing policies first if re-running). Then NOTIFY pgrst, 'reload schema'; verify with the curl loop in this report.
